Verified end-to-end.

- Exact theorem: `AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.inf` in `.lake-packages/mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Affine.lean:327-329`:
  ```lean
  lemma IsAffineOpen.inf
      [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
      (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
      IsAffineOpen (U ⊓ V)
  ```
- Under `[X.IsSeparated]`, the affine-diagonal instance synthesizes automatically:
  `Scheme.IsSeparated.isSeparated_terminal_from` (`Morphisms/Separated.lean:330-334`) → diagonal `IsClosedImmersion` (`:44-53`) → `[IsClosedImmersion f] : IsAffineHom f` (`Morphisms/ClosedImmersion.lean:149-150`).
- Compiled probe:
  ```lean
  example {X : Scheme} [X.IsSeparated] {U V : X.Opens}
      (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
      IsAffineOpen (U ⊓ V) := by
    exact hU.inf hV
  ```
  `lake env lean` exits 0. `MilneLib/StableAffineSections.lean` also now compiles cleanly.

A stable chart pair can be packaged as `StableAffineOpen` (`U`, `affine`, `stable`), with overlap:
```lean
overlap_stable := by
  intro g
  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, i.stable g, j.stable g]
overlap_affine := i.affine.inf j.affine
```

For a stable `U`, the induced section endomorphism is
```lean
(act g).hom.appLE U U (hU g).ge
```
with composition laws from `Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app` and `Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE`; inverse transport yields `MulSemiringAction G Γ(X,U)`. Restriction maps use `resLE`, with `resLE_comp_ι`, `resLE_id`, and `resLE_comp_resLE`. Equivariance of restriction follows from `appLE_map`/`map_appLE`. Bare `act : G →* Aut X` gives only the ring action; an explicit base map and compatibility are still needed for `Algebra`/semilinearity. No project files were edited.
